name: PaymentInput
summary: Collect and format a payment card number with bounded card-type detection.

useWhen: Collecting a primary payment card number during checkout.
avoidWhen: For payment details other than a card number; use TextField.
For a generic number; use NumberField.

obligations: Strips non-digits and formats Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover groups.
Formatting and card detection do not validate payment credentials.

behavior: Non-digit characters are stripped as the user types.
Numbers starting with 34 or 37 are Amex and group as 4, 6, and 5; every other number groups as 4, 4, 4, and 4.
Digits past the last group are dropped: 15 digits for Amex, 16 for any other card.
Root's onChange receives the formatted string, spaces included, not the digits and not an event.
value and defaultValue take digits or formatted text, and the field shows either formatted.
A named PaymentInput.Input submits the formatted string, spaces included.
The card type is detected from the leading digits only.
Formatting and card detection do not validate payment credentials.
CardIcon renders one generic card glyph marked aria-hidden, the same for every card type, and renders no card brand.
CardIcon records the card type as data-card-type metadata, taken from detection or from its cardType prop.
PaymentInput processes no payment: sending the number to a payment provider and handling its response belong to the application.
Error shows only while the field is invalid.
Interactive control sizes use the shared sm, md, and lg targets; md is the default.
accessibility: Strips non-digits and formats Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Discover groups.
Formatting and card detection do not validate payment credentials.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
